PROJECTS
High-Concurrency Real-Time Chat Application § Git repo Present
• Performance & Scale: Learning to validate and enhance system scalability by engineering k6 load-testing scripts to simulate
thousands of concurrent connections, and visualizing real-time telemetry in Grafana.
• Architected a real-time messaging server using FastAPI and WebSockets, deployed on an AWS EC2 instance with an Nginx
reverse proxy to avoid cold starts of free cloud services and to optimize the usage of limited free EC2 hrs for multiple apps.
• Tech Stack/Tools: Python, FastAPI, AWS EC2, Nginx, k6, Grafana, SQLite, WebSockets, CI/CD Pipeline.
Hexagon — Immersive Learning Platform § Git repo Nov 2025
• Built a next-generation learning platform featuring 3D VR classrooms and real-time student interaction.

• Tech Stack/Tools: React, React Three Fiber, Node.js, MongoDB, Socket.IO, Google Gemini API, Redis.
SAAS - Seat Allotment & Admission Management System § Git repo Apr 2025
• Built a C++ Seat-Allotment engine for the University using advanced Data Structures to process multi-level quota logic.
• Impact: Handled data of 5,000+ applicants, reducing manual administrative work by approx. 80% and eliminating errors.
• Tech Stack: C++, Node.js, MongoDB, React.
